title: Scaffold Vite + React + TypeScript app with Vitest
notes: npm create vite with react-ts template; add vitest, @testing-library/react, jsdom; configure vitest.config.ts. Tests verify: npm run build exits 0; npm test runs an empty suite without errors.

title: Define controlled vocabularies and TypeScript types
notes: src/types/index.ts: all const enums/union types from ARCHITECTURE.md (IngredientCategory, CookingStage, Role, BalanceAxis, Trait, CuisineTag, SaltRisk, GroupTag, IngredientRef) plus core object types (Ingredient, BuildIngredient, StewBuild, AnalysisResult, AnalysisMessage, GeneratedRecipe). Also define GROUPS constant mapping each GroupTag to its member definition (category or explicit ID list). Tests verify TypeScript compiles; spot-check that COOKING_STAGE_ORDER tuple is exhaustive.

title: Runtime schema validation for ingredient JSON (zod)
notes: src/catalog/schema.ts: IngredientSchema using zod with .enum() guards on all controlled vocabularies. Export validateIngredient(unknown): Ingredient and validateCatalog(unknown[]): Ingredient[]. Tests: valid record passes; record with unknown category rejects; record with unknown cuisine rejects; record with missing required field rejects. Error messages must name the offending field and value.

title: CSV→JSON converter script
notes: scripts/convert-catalog.ts (run with tsx): reads insta_the_pot_ingredients_v2.csv, outputs src/catalog/ingredients.json. Must: split ";" delimited cells (roles, traits, cuisines, pairs_with, avoid_with); parse balance_scores JSON string; omit cookMinutes when cook_min/cook_max blank; map raw cuisine strings to CuisineTag via the 18-tag consolidation table from ARCHITECTURE.md; classify each pairsWith/avoidWith token as GroupTag (if in GROUP_TAGS set) or IngredientId; halt with typed error on vocabulary drift, unresolved ID ref, or group-tag/ID namespace collision. Add to package.json scripts as convert:catalog. Unit tests for: semicolon splitter, cuisine consolidation mapper, ref classifier, balance-scores parser.

title: Seed fixture and end-to-end catalog integrity proof
notes: Create fixtures/seed_ingredients.csv with 10-15 hand-authored ingredients spanning all 8 stages (brown, aromatics, deglaze, pressure, simmer_after, stir_in, finish, serve_over). Must include at least: one with pairsWith group ref, one with pairsWith direct ID ref, one with cuisineWeights, one with cookMinutes present, one with cookMinutes blank. Run converter on fixture. Catalog integrity test suite: no duplicate IDs; every pairsWith/avoidWith token resolves to a known ingredient ID in the fixture OR to a valid GroupTag; group tags and ingredient IDs are disjoint; every group referenced has >=1 member in the fixture catalog.

title: Run full CSV catalog conversion
notes: Add convert:catalog script to package.json (tsx scripts/convert-catalog.ts). Run converter on insta_the_pot_ingredients_v2.csv to produce src/catalog/ingredients.json. Tests verify: output file exists; record count >= 100; every record passes ingredientSchema; no duplicate IDs; converter exits 0 with no warnings.

title: Catalog loader with load-time integrity validation
notes: src/catalog/index.ts: import ingredients.json statically; validate every record with ingredientSchema at module load; run integrity checks (no duplicate IDs, every pairsWith/avoidWith token is a known GroupTag or an ingredient ID in the catalog, group tags and ingredient IDs are disjoint, every group has >= 1 member in the catalog). Expose getIngredient(id), listIngredients(filters?). Tests: catalog loads 119 records; getIngredient returns correct record; getIngredient unknown ID returns undefined; listIngredients with category filter returns correct subset; integrity checks throw on injected duplicate/broken-ref catalog.

title: Immutable build operations
notes: src/store/buildReducer.ts: implement addIngredient, removeIngredient, moveIngredient, updateBuildIngredient — each takes (build: StewBuild, ...) and returns a new StewBuild without mutating the input. Export UnknownIngredientError (typed Error subclass). Invariants: at most one row per ingredient ID (addIngredient throws UnknownIngredientError if ID unknown, is a no-op or throws on duplicate — choose throw for clarity); remove/move/update throw UnknownIngredientError for unknown IDs; all functions are pure (no catalog import — catalog is passed as parameter where needed for ID validation). Tests: add creates new object leaving original unchanged; double-add throws; remove removes; move changes stage; update patches quantity/unit without touching other fields; unknown-ID operations all throw UnknownIngredientError; cross-product: add+move+remove sequence on same ID.

title: React build store
notes: src/store/index.ts: React context + useReducer wrapping buildReducer actions. Expose useBuildStore() hook returning {build, dispatch}. Action union: AddIngredient, RemoveIngredient, MoveIngredient, UpdateBuildIngredient. Errors from buildReducer propagate as thrown exceptions. BuildStoreProvider wraps the app. Tests: hook returns initial empty build; dispatch AddIngredient action updates build; dispatch RemoveIngredient removes it; dispatch MoveIngredient changes stage field; dispatch unknown action leaves build unchanged.

title: Minimal stage-grouped build summary UI
notes: src/components/BuildSummary.tsx: renders a text list of the current build grouped by stage in canonical stage order (brown, aromatics, deglaze, pressure, simmer_after, stir_in, finish, serve_over). Each non-empty stage shows its name and ingredient names. Empty stages are omitted. src/App.tsx: renders BuildSummary inside BuildStoreProvider; includes a hardcoded demo add of two or three ingredients from the loaded catalog to prove catalog -> build -> UI flow. Tests: render BuildSummary with a build containing ingredients in multiple stages; verify stage headings appear in canonical order; verify ingredient names appear under the correct stage; verify empty stages produce no heading; end-to-end render: App renders without errors and shows at least one ingredient name.

title: App shell + four-column layout
notes: App.tsx with Header (app title + build name from store) and four equal-width columns: Library, Detail, Timeline, Analysis — each a stub with a title. Tests: four columns render with correct headings; header shows build name.

title: Library column — category tabs and ingredient cards
notes: All IngredientCategory tabs in a fixed canonical order (protein → aromatics → liquid → roots → vegetable → legumes → grains → greens → fat → topping → spice). Clicking a tab filters the ingredient list. Compact card: name + salt-risk badge. Clicking a card dispatches select-ingredient action. Tests: all 11 tabs render; active tab filters to correct ingredients; card face shows name and salt-risk only.

title: Library — name search (composes with tab filter)
notes: Text input above ingredient list; case-insensitive substring match on ingredient name. Filter composes with active category tab (AND). Tests: search narrows the list; combined search+tab produces correct intersection; clearing search restores full tab list.

title: Detail column — ingredient metadata panel + stage picker
notes: Detail column shows full ingredient record when one is selected: name, category, stage default, roles, traits, balance-score bars (labeled by axis), cuisines, saltRisk, cookMinutes range, pairsWith, avoidWith, notes. Empty-state placeholder when nothing is selected. Stage picker: 8 CookingStage chips in canonical order; ingredient default stage pre-highlighted; if already in build, current build stage highlighted instead. Escape key clears selection. Clicking a chip calls addIngredient (or moveIngredient if already in build). Tests: metadata fields render correctly; empty state; default stage chip highlighted; already-placed ingredient shows current stage; Escape dismisses; chip click updates build.

title: Stage Timeline column
notes: Vertical list of all 8 stages in canonical order (brown → aromatics → deglaze → pressure → simmer_after → stir_in → finish → serve_over). Every stage is always rendered; empty stages show a greyed header with no cards. Placed ingredient cards show: name and cookMinutes range (if present). Each card has a remove button. Tests: all 8 stages present in canonical order; placed ingredients appear in their correct stage; empty stages still render; remove button calls removeIngredient and card disappears.

title: Keyboard accessibility — place and remove flows
notes: Tab order: Library search input → category tabs → ingredient cards → (when Detail open) stage chips → Timeline remove buttons. Enter/Space on an ingredient card loads Detail. Tab to a stage chip, Enter/Space places/moves. Escape clears Detail without placing. Tab to remove button in Timeline, Enter/Space removes. No interactive element should be pointer-only. Tests: keyboard-only flow successfully places an ingredient (search → card → stage chip) and removes it (Timeline remove button) with no mouse events; focus is visible throughout.

title: Analysis column placeholder + Phase 3 acceptance test
notes: Analysis column renders a static placeholder: ingredient count, stages populated count, and a note that balance/cuisine/warnings arrive in Phase 4. Phase 3 acceptance test: render full composer; click a protein tab; click chicken ingredient; verify Detail opens with correct name; click pressure stage chip; verify Timeline shows chicken in pressure stage; click remove; verify build is empty. Tests: placeholder renders; full composer E2E flow passes.

title: Analysis types + analyzeBuild skeleton
notes: Add AnalysisResult, AnalysisMessage, TimingFinding, IngredientSuggestion to types.ts. Create src/analysis.ts with analyzeBuild(build, catalog) returning a zeroed-out AnalysisResult stub. Tests verify the return shape and that it is pure (same input → same output).

title: Balance axis scoring
notes: Sum each ingredients balanceScores across all 10 axes. Tests: empty build yields all-zero scores; single ingredient contributes its exact values; multi-ingredient build sums correctly including overlapping axes.

title: Cuisine affinity scoring
notes: Per ingredient: if cuisineWeights present use those values; else contribute 1 per cuisines tag. Omit universal from ranked output. Tests: default-weight ingredient contributes 1 per tag; cuisineWeights override; universal excluded from result; ranked order is descending by score.

title: Pairing and avoidance synergies
notes: Resolve each pairsWith/avoidWith IngredientRef: GroupTag resolves to member set via GROUP_DEFINITIONS; IngredientId matches directly. A ref counts at most once even if group+member both match. Pairs treated as symmetric: A.pairsWith B counts even if B.pairsWith omits A. Tests: ID match; group match; group+member dedup; symmetric resolution; avoidWith caution message emitted; severity=info for synergy, severity=warning for caution.

title: Timing findings
notes: For each build ingredient with a catalog cookMinutes range: compare against build.pressureMinutes (if present). Below min → likely undercooked. Above max → likely to soften/shred/dissolve. Within range → appropriate. Tests: no pressureMinutes → no timing findings; undercook case; overcook case with descriptive message; within-range is silent.

title: Stage placement warnings
notes: Three deterministic rules: (1) Miso in any stage other than finish/stir_in → suggest moving to finish. (2) Spinach in pressure stage → suggest moving to stir_in. (3) Couscous in any stage other than serve_over → suggest moving to serve_over. Tests: each rule fires on correct condition; does not fire when stage is correct; two rules can fire simultaneously (cross-product).

title: Composition warnings and gap suggestions
notes: Five deterministic rules: (1) richness>=4 AND acidity+freshness<2 → suggest acid or fresh herbs. (2) legume category count>=1 AND grain category count>=1 AND root category count>=2 → warn excessive body/starch. (3) Ham hock or smoked sausage present AND (stock OR miso OR parmesan present) → warn salt accumulation. (4) Dried beans present AND tomato-category ingredients present → warn slow softening. (5) No greens AND freshness<2 → suggest spinach/peas/herbs/scallions. Threshold values are provisional (see D-25). Tests: each rule fires/silent; rules are disjoint (fire independently when coexisting); the cross-product build triggers rules 1+2 simultaneously.

title: Ten representative fixture builds
notes: Create tests/fixtures/builds.ts with at least 10 typed StewBuild constants covering: (1) chicken-roots-barley-spinach-lemon (reference E2E build), (2) heavy/rich (ham hock + beans + roots), (3) bright/acid (lemon-forward French), (4) bean-forward, (5) root-forward, (6) French affinity (white wine, butter, thyme, leek), (7) Mexican affinity (cumin, chili, chipotle, lime), (8) Japanese/East-Asian affinity (miso, ginger, soy, scallion), (9) greens-heavy/low-body, (10) cross-product: triggers stage placement + composition warnings simultaneously. Each fixture documents its expected AnalysisResult shape (top cuisine, warning IDs, timing outcome). Tests assert analyzer output matches expectations.

title: Wire analysis into Analysis column UI
notes: Replace the Phase 3 static placeholder in the Analysis column with live AnalysisResult: (1) balance bars for each of the 10 axes (proportional width, labeled); (2) ranked cuisine scores (excluding universal, no percentages); (3) warnings list with severity badge (info/warning); (4) suggestions list. Analysis reruns on every build change. Tests: column renders balance bars; cuisine list excludes universal; warning badge shows severity; empty build renders gracefully.

title: Instruction Generator
notes: Add GeneratedRecipe and InstructionStep types to types.ts. Implement src/instructions.ts exporting generateInstructions(build, catalog, analysis): GeneratedRecipe. Emit one or more instructions per non-empty stage in canonical order (brown, aromatics, deglaze, pressure, simmer_after, stir_in, finish, serve_over); omit empty stages entirely. Ingredient notes may append handling clauses; do not invent quantities, temperatures, or times absent from the build or catalog. Also produce a plainText rendering. Unit tests: canonical stage order; empty-stage omission; note injection; no invented quantities; plain-text contains all non-empty stage headings.

title: Persistence Adapter
notes: Add SavedBuildRecord type to types.ts (includes schemaVersion). Implement src/persistence.ts exporting: saveBuild, loadBuild, listSavedBuilds, deleteBuild (localStorage CRUD), exportBuild (serialise to JSON with schemaVersion), importBuild (parse JSON, validate schemaVersion present, verify every ingredientId resolves in the catalog, surface unknown IDs as an ImportError). Storage failures must throw or return an error object — never silently discard the current build. Unit tests: round-trip save/load; list returns all saved records; delete removes entry; export includes schemaVersion; importBuild accepts valid JSON; importBuild rejects missing schemaVersion; importBuild rejects unknown ingredient IDs listing the bad IDs.

title: Pressure and release time UI controls
notes: Add numeric inputs for pressureMinutes and naturalReleaseMinutes to the Stage Timeline column (near the Pressure stage lane or in a build-metadata section). Wire to the build store so changes update StewBuild fields. Both fields are optional; omit from instructions when blank. Component tests: inputs render; changing a value updates the store; values persist across renders.

title: Instructions panel in BuildSummary
notes: Call generateInstructions in App.tsx (alongside analyzeBuild) and pass the result to BuildSummary or a new InstructionsPanel component. Render the ordered step list with stage headings. Add a copy-to-clipboard button that copies the plainText rendering. Empty build renders a placeholder (no steps). Component tests: steps render in canonical stage order; copy button present; empty build renders gracefully; stage headings match non-empty stages only.

title: Saved Builds UI
notes: Add save-current-build button to the app header. Add a Saved Builds panel (toggle or sidebar) listing all SavedBuildRecords with: restore (overwrites current build), delete, and rename actions. Add export-to-JSON (triggers browser download) and import-from-JSON (file picker) controls. Display import errors inline — unknown IDs or invalid schema. Component tests: save button calls saveBuild; list renders saved builds; restore calls loadBuild and updates store; delete removes entry from list; import error message renders on bad JSON; export triggers download.

title: End-to-end test: chicken/roots/barley/spinach/lemon
notes: Integration test in tests/acceptance/phase_5/: build the canonical reference fixture (chicken thighs pressure stage, carrot+parsnip pressure stage, pearl barley pressure stage, spinach stir_in stage, lemon juice finish stage). Call generateInstructions and assert: pressure stage step present, stir_in step present, finish step present; brown/aromatics/deglaze omitted when empty. Call saveBuild, then loadBuild, assert round-trip preserves all BuildIngredient fields and pressureMinutes. Assert analyzeBuild still returns expected warnings (spinach-in-pressure caution if applicable based on stage; high-body composition if applicable). This test must pass with tsc --noEmit clean and all prior acceptance suites intact.

title: Define Technique/CookingStep types and register braise
notes: Add Technique and CookingStep interfaces to types.ts. Create src/techniques.ts with the braise technique constant: 8 steps reusing current CookingStage ids (brown, aromatics, deglaze, pressure, simmer_after, stir_in, finish, serve_over); pressure step has longCook: true and label Oven / pressure cook. Tests: braise has 8 steps; pressure step has longCook; step ids are valid CookingStage values.

title: Add compatibleSteps to Ingredient type and zod schema
notes: Add compatibleSteps: string[] to the Ingredient TypeScript interface in types.ts. Update the zod schema in schema.ts to require compatibleSteps as a non-empty array of step id strings. Tests: zod rejects an ingredient missing compatibleSteps; zod rejects an ingredient with an empty array; valid ingredient with compatibleSteps passes validation.

title: Update CSV→JSON converter to emit compatibleSteps
notes: In scripts/convert-catalog.ts, after resolving an ingredient stage, set compatibleSteps: [stage] (for braise, each ingredient is step-appropriate only at its default stage). Run the converter to regenerate src/ingredients.json. Tests: converter unit test verifying a sample ingredient row gets compatibleSteps: [stage]; converter rejects a row if stage is not a valid CookingStage id.

title: Catalog integrity tests for compatibleSteps + full test-suite green
notes: Add catalog integrity tests: every ingredient has compatibleSteps with at least one entry; every entry is a valid braise step id (one of the 8 CookingStage values); compatibleSteps contains the ingredient default stage. Confirm all 290+ existing tests pass with no regressions. No UI changes; app must build and run.

title: Define Suggestion types and scoreStep scaffold
notes: Add Reason and Suggestion types to types.ts. Create src/scoring.ts with scoreStep(step, build, catalog, cuisine?) stub returning []. TypeScript compiles; all existing tests pass. No logic yet.

title: Balance and pairing dimension
notes: For each step-appropriate, not-yet-placed ingredient: (a) score fills-low-axis — sum of contributions to axes where build total is below a low threshold; (b) penalize overload-high-axis — for axes already at or above a high threshold, adding more subtracts; (c) pairsWith hit against current build adds a boost and the balance reason tag; (d) avoidWith hit adds a penalty, the caution reason tag, and a caution note. Unit tests: fill-low, overload-high, pairsWith boost, avoidWith caution, both at once.

title: Cuisine soft-boost dimension
notes: When a cuisine direction is supplied: for each candidate ingredient, if any of its cuisines (or cuisineWeights keys) matches the chosen cuisine tag, add a soft boost weighted by cuisineWeights[cuisine] or 1.0 default. Attach reason cuisine. Never filter — ingredients without a cuisine match still appear. Unit tests: no cuisine arg (dimension silent), matching cuisine boosts, mismatched cuisine unchanged, universal-tagged ingredient not double-boosted.

title: Timing dimension at long-cook step
notes: Active only when the target CookingStep has longCook: true. Reference cook window = max cookMinutes.max among already-selected ingredients (skip if none have cookMinutes). For each candidate: if candidate.cookMinutes.max << reference max (threshold: less than half), caution it as likely to dissolve/overcook — attach timing reason and a caution note. Candidates without cookMinutes are neutral. At non-longCook steps the timing dimension contributes nothing. Unit tests: non-longCook step (dimension silent), longCook with no selected cook times (silent), candidate well below reference (caution), candidate within range (neutral), candidate above range (neutral).

title: Bucket assignment, sorting, and integration
notes: Combine dimension scores into a single total. Apply provisional thresholds: Top (score >= HIGH_THRESH), Okay (score >= LOW_THRESH), Fallback (remainder). Sort within each bucket by descending score. Emit Suggestion[] in Top-first order. Collect all reason tags (balance, cuisine, timing, caution) that fired for each ingredient. Integration tests: multiple dimensions active simultaneously; reason tags reflect which dimensions fired; bucket thresholds separate expected candidates; already-placed ingredients are excluded; step-inappropriate ingredients are excluded.

title: Fixture builds and threshold tuning
notes: Author 4-5 named fixture scenarios in tests/fixtures/scoring_fixtures.ts: (1) empty build at aromatics step — breadth of suggestions, no pairsWith context; (2) French-leaning build (chicken + aromatics + wine) at stir_in step — cuisine boost for french-tagged finishers; (3) root-heavy + grain build at finish step — balance dimension pushes freshness/acidity candidates to Top; (4) empty build at pressure (longCook) step — timing caution for quick-cook items like spinach/couscous; (5) avoidWith conflict scenario — verify caution reason fires. Document expected bucket for the top-3 candidates in each fixture. Tune HIGH_THRESH/LOW_THRESH constants until all expected assignments pass. Accept ±1 bucket only for borderline documented cases.
